tip.id: A unique identifier for this resource (e.g. gpt-4o or my-workflow). Used in API calls and must not collide with another resource.
tip.tenant: Which tenant owns this resource (its credits are charged).
tip.kind: Model = a single upstream model; Workflow = a multi-step pipeline (e.g. a Dify app).
tip.modality: The primary data type this resource handles: text, image, video, audio, or composite.
tip.providerType: Free-text upstream provider (e.g. openai, anthropic). The logo resolves from this value.
tip.execModes: How callers may invoke this resource: blocking, stream, async-poll or async-callback. Press Enter to add.

detail.pick: Select a resource to view details

tip.name: The unique model id callers request (e.g. anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet). Immutable after creation.
tip.resource: Which resource/upstream this model routes to.
tip.display: Optional human-readable label shown in lists.
tip.modality: The data type this model handles. Immutable after creation.
tip.capabilities: Features this model supports — toggle the ones that apply.
tip.visibility: Public = available to all tenants; Tenant = only granted tenants can use it.
tip.visibilityTenant: Tenant-only: grant access per tenant from the grants drawer.
tip.price: Price in µcredits per token. 1 credit = 1,000,000 µcredits.
tip.status: Disabled models are hidden from callers.

grant.title: Grants · {{name}}
grant.note: Public models are open to all tenants. Grants only gate tenant-visibility models.

confirm.deleteMsg: Permanently delete model {{name}}? This frees the name for re-create and cannot be undone.
confirm.revokeMsg: Revoke access for {{tenant}}? They will no longer be able to use this model.

tip.provider: Free-text upstream provider for this channel (e.g. openai, anthropic). The logo resolves from this value.
tip.endpoint: Override base URL for this channel. Leave empty to use the provider default.
tip.model: Upstream model name to call (e.g. gpt-4o). Leave empty to use the resource default.
tip.proxyRef: Optional reference to an outbound proxy configuration.
tip.weight: Routing weight — higher values receive a larger share of traffic across active channels.
tip.cost: Operator cost — what you pay upstream per 1M tokens. Used to compute margin against resale price. Leave 0 to omit.
tip.status: Disabled channels are skipped by routing.
tip.credentialRef: Id of the encrypted secret holding this channel's API key. Use "New credential" to create one.
tip.config: Provider-specific key/value settings for this channel (e.g. async submit/poll paths).

tip.value: The plaintext API key or secret. It is encrypted on save and never shown again — only its id is kept as a reference.

tip.method: How the price is computed: unit rate, matrix table, fixed amount, formula, or pass-through of upstream cost.
tip.timing: Pre = charge an estimate before the call; Post = charge the actual usage after the call completes.
tip.fixedCredits: The flat price in human credits (1 credit = 1,000,000 µcredits). The backend converts it to µcredits.
tip.resourceVersion: The resource version this price applies to. Defaults to the resource's current version.
tip.version: Version number for this price entry; bump it to supersede an earlier price.

mock.note: This page runs on in-memory demo data until its billing backend ships. Edits are not saved.

tip.provider: Upstream provider this price is published by (e.g. openai, anthropic). The logo resolves from this value.
tip.modelSlug: The provider's model identifier (e.g. gpt-4o or claude-3-5-sonnet).
tip.price: Price in US dollars per 1M tokens. Stored as integer µUSD ($1 = 1,000,000 µUSD).
tip.cachedInputPrice: Optional discounted rate for cached input tokens, per 1M.
tip.effectiveAt: The date this published price takes effect.
tip.sourceUrl: Link to the provider's pricing page this figure was taken from.

confirm.deleteMsg: Permanently delete the price for {{model}}? This cannot be undone.

tip.name: A unique name for this routing group (e.g. default, premium).
tip.ratioPercent: Group price ratio as a percent — 100 = ×1.00 (official price), 150 = ×1.50 (+50%). Stored as basis points.
tip.ratioLive: Group price ratio — 100 = ×1.00 (official price), 150 = ×1.50. This multiplies REAL customer billing for keys bound to this group. Stored as basis points.
tip.status: Disabled groups are skipped by routing.
tip.description: Optional note describing what this group is for.

confirm.deleteMsg: Permanently delete the {{name}} group? Its channel membership is removed too. This cannot be undone.

io.inputsHint: The request parameters callers send to this resource.
io.outputsHint: The fields this resource returns in its response.
io.keyHint: Machine name (no spaces), e.g. prompt or image_url.
io.typeHint: The value type. Choose enum to constrain to a fixed set of options.
io.fieldLabelHint: Optional human-readable label for this field.
io.maxLengthHint: Optional character cap (string and file only). 0 = no limit.
io.optionsHint: Allowed values — required for an enum field.

spec.muCreditNote: Amounts here are µcredits — 1 credit = 1,000,000 µcredits.
spec.keyHint: The dimensions that compose each table key (order matters).
spec.cellKeyHint: Join multiple key values with | — e.g. 720p|fast.
spec.multiplierHint: Request variable to multiply the matched cell by.
spec.perItemHint: Request variable charged once per item.
spec.exprHint: Allowed: integers, variable names and + - * ( ). No / % or decimals.
spec.exprTooltip: Variable names come from the request parameters.
spec.exprError: Only + - * ( ), integers and variable names are allowed.
spec.markupPercentHint: Whole percent added on top of the upstream cost.
spec.markupFlatHint: Flat µcredits added on top of the upstream cost.
spec.fixedNote: Set the price via the Fixed credits field in the pricing form.
